g1_vertical: Vertical: golden yellow on top to vibrant orange at the bottom (the original gradient).
g2_diagonal: Diagonal: bright yellow top-left to deep orange bottom-right.
g3_radial: Radial: a soft yellow glow behind the logo and heroes, orange at the edges.
g4_sunset: Three stops: yellow to orange to red, warmer and heavier at the bottom.
g5_flat: Almost flat orange: the plainest option, everything rides on the characters.
g6_sky: Off-brand test: Crab Champions sky blue, the warm characters pop against it.
g7_teal: Off-brand test: teal, cool contrast for the orange capybara.
g8_purple: Off-brand test: magenta to purple, Ophelia's colors.
